title: Schürstab Codex: Astrological-Medical Treatises (ZB Zurich, C 54)
shelf_note: A 15th-century German manuscript leaf of computus tables (moveable feasts keyed to Sunday letters) belongs with an astrological-medical codex. No tradition or collection is set to check against.
structure_note: All 136 pages have OCR. pages_translated_field says 119 but the structure count of translated pages is 0, so the two counts disagree. 14 backsteps and 8 repeats among 54 printed numbers. In a manuscript with sparse, faint folio numbers in the corner (this leaf has '58'), misread or mixed foliation is the likely cause, not a splice. One page cannot settle it.

pages.layout: ruled calendar table in red and black ink: three blocks headed 'viii octo', 'novem', 'decem', rows A–g with red Sunday letters, column labels written vertically under the blocks, mirror-image show-through from the verso in both margins

book_verdict: A clear computus table, but the OCR reverses the column heads against the data, so each syllable is tied to the wrong feast. The translation's note turns that error into a false claim about the table's order. Marginal biblical names that are not legible on this side of the leaf are also transcribed and interpreted.
